aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable evidence but overmerges distinct tests and uses an unsafe normal-vs-test comparison.
issues: Changed factor combines Type 1 holder-position test with Type 2 VP-not-spread test.
Primary comparison uses Normal row from Type 1 against VP-not-spread row from Type 2.
Changed condition includes subgroup details as if all are one factor.
Measurement outcome is extracted from count columns, not a separate measurement domain.
Several cited rows needed for grouping are not shown in the review context.
correctionPlan: Split Type 1 holder-position and Type 2 VP-not-spread into separate changed-factor contexts or keep only the supported one.
For Type 2, compare Test VP not spread only against Normal rows within the same section and preserve line/date as subgroup keys.
For Type 1, compare each position or holder condition against its matching normal baseline if rows support it.
Remove the measurement outcome or recast defect categories as sub-defect counts under process defect.
Expose and cite the actual rows for all selected comparison records and headers.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but current citations are not sufficient because comparison grouping is not reliable.
